text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Interior Minister Minister Alberto Costa bought 6,000 pistols from Chile without putting contract out to tender.
- Anglo-French paper group Arjo Wiggins unhappy at Economy Minister's plan for them to be "strategic partner" in reorganised Portuguese pulp and paper sector.
- Lisbon's Expo-98 world exhibition chief Antonio Cardoso & Cunha irritates Socialist government which does not accept his explanations for rising costs.
- General-inspector for the health service Moreira Rodrigues wants an investigation of hospitals and health centres.
- Finance Ministry threatens new penalties for companies which do not come forward to settle past tax and social security debts.
- Glass company Barbosa & Almeida is to invest around nine billion escudos in a new factory in either Portugal or Spain.
- State electricity company EDP's 10 major clients threaten to import energy if the Government does not lower electricity prices.
